text:
maya: Heads up — thinking about adding a per-route 'inspector' panel in Console analytics. It'd surface routing policy, quota usage, recent fallback events, and top prompts triggering quality alerts. Thoughts?

sam: +1. We should tie it to saved queries so SRE/product can pin filters for on-call. Also show which model variant handled each request (quantized vs full-precision).

jorge: Agree. UX question: do we show a compact metrics header (p50/p95 latency, error %, tokens per request, cost/unit) and then a drilldown for raw samples/logs?

eva: Prefer header + a small sparkline for the last 2h with quick links: Open logs, Open traces, Export. Important: redact PII by default when showing samples.

alex: Technical constraint: we currently index routing-policy metadata for 30d only. If inspector needs longer view per saved query we'd have to either extend retention or provide an on-demand archive. @maya what's preferred?

maya: Let's avoid changing global retention. Proposal: add an "archive for query" action that spins up a job to pull route logs + policy snapshots into long-term store for that saved query ID. Keep default short retention for infra cost.

console-bot: Note: audit/export jobs require Enterprise plan. See /docs/console-exports for limits and costs.

sam: UX note — saved-query modal should let you choose scope: org / team / personal. Default to team for cross-team routes. Also include a toggle for "include archived data". :thumbsup:

jorge: Also want to pin model-variant filters and visualize rollout history (timestamped steps, pct traffic, model id). That helps debug incremental regressions.

maya: For rollout history, can we reuse the existing rollouts API? Alex?

alex: Yes — we already expose /api/v1/rollouts. Example: `GET /api/v1/routes/{route_id}/rollouts` returns an array of {timestamp, pct, model_id}. We'll wire that into the inspector timeline. Quick example in logs: `GET /api/v1/routes/rt-12345/rollouts` -> [ {"ts":"2026-02-18T12:10:00Z","pct":10,"model_id":"redwood-t5-q8"}, {"ts":"2026-02-18T12:40:00Z","pct":100,"model_id":"redwood-t5-q8"} ]`

eva: One more: default filter presets for the inspector should include: "last 24h errors", "top cost contributors", "recent fallbacks", and "high-latency requests". Those make onboarding easier for SREs.

sam: I'll mock a quick Figma with header variants + inspector pane. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maya: Great — @sam drop the figma link here and I'll spin up a short RFC and link to it. Thanks everyone!
